name: malohat-pishiriqlari
description: Malohat pishiriqlari — Telegram Mini App (bot + API + Next.js)

scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "FRONTEND,BOT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n "FRONTEND,BOT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix frontend run start" "npm --prefix backend run start"
